neighbours.label: the word introducing a name or title after a naming verb ('as' in 'known as', 'popularly known as')
fire: The striker, widely known as El Toro, scored twice in the final.
The old fort, locally known as the Red House, is now a museum.
The four musicians, collectively known as the Quartet, toured Europe.
The disease, commonly known as lockjaw, is caused by a bacterium.
His grandmother, affectionately known as Nana, lived to be a hundred.
The comet, now known as Halley's comet, returns every 76 years.
The neighbourhood, better known as Little Italy, is full of cafes.
The treaty, popularly known as the Paris Agreement, was signed in 2015.
quiet: The striker, who is very fast, scored twice in the final.
The old fort, built of red brick, is now a museum.
The four musicians, all from Lisbon, toured Europe.
The disease, which affects the muscles, is caused by a bacterium.
His grandmother, a retired nurse, lived to be a hundred.
The comet, first seen in ancient times, returns every 76 years.
The neighbourhood, near the river, is full of cafes.
The treaty, after years of talks, was signed in 2015.

notes: Card top 32: ' the' x14, ' as' x6; clearest examples are 'popularly known as' and 'collectively known as'; others mixed (blowing of the Shofar, aboard the). Moderate density 0.7%.
